paper_title: Do Consistency Metrics Rank Long-Document Summarizers the Way Annotators Do?
contributions: A human consistency annotation of 600 summaries of 200 long documents from three systems, with two annotators and adjudication.
A system-level and summary-level comparison of SummaC and QAFactEval with the human judgements, overall and in three document-length buckets.
Evidence that both metrics keep the human ranking of systems at every length while the summary-level discrimination of SummaC weakens on the longest documents.
